text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki and I are watching the Arima Kinen. Oguri Cap is as popular as ever, but there are rumors that something's been off with her recently.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even after stepping onto the track, Oguri Cap doesn't raise her head once. Yaeno Muteki attempts to talk some sense into her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap receives her strength from her supporters. That's why she has to pick her head up and feel their support. Hearing this, Oguri Cap is reinvigorated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Yaeno Muteki commends Oguri Cap for her recovery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap expresses her gratitude and reveals that next time, she wants to race against Yaeno Muteki.
